rows.en: Jack...! ...It couldn't be helped. They're formidable foes.
Brother Jack...! ...It couldn't be helped. They're formidable opponents.
...Can't be helped, man. Those guys are tough.
Problem is, though... their next opponent is us.
What...!? Then you'd better watch out. They had Black King hidden away as an ambush.
They had Black King hidden away as an ambush.
What did you say?
We had the upper hand at first, too. But then, out of nowhere, one who was never even entered...
Black King appeared, and the tide turned against us in one stroke...
Hmph! What a dirty trick...!!
Understood, thank you. We'll avenge you, without fail!!
You all go back to base and focus on recovering.
Understood, thank you. We'll avenge you, without fail!!
You all go back to base and focus on recovering.
Understood! We'll avenge you, I promise!!
Brothers, please go back to base and focus on recovering!
I won't let this slide!! I'll pay them back for you, count on it!!
You guys head back to base and focus on recovering!
Yes... We'll do just that.
You'd better hurry to the next venue. There isn't much time left.
Jack, Ace, Accel and Birth headed back to base.
This is District B... This is where Jack's team...
Everyone, I'm sorry... We, of all people... lost to the Alien Alliance...
To the Alien Alliance... we lost...
Jack...! ...Don't worry about it. They're tough, right?
Yeah...
Hmph! Never mind that. The problem is that we're their next opponent.
What...!? Then you'd better watch out. They had Black King hidden away as an ambush.
They had Black King hidden away as an ambush.
What?
We had the upper hand at first, too. But then, out of nowhere, one who was never even entered...
Black King appeared, and the tide turned against us in one stroke...
Tch! What a dirty trick...!!
Understood! We'll avenge you, I promise!!
Everyone, please go back to base and focus on recovering.
Got it, thanks. We'll settle the score for you, count on it!!
You guys go back to base and focus on getting better.
Allll right! Got it!! I'll get payback for you myself!!
You lot just stay at base and focus on healing up!!
Unforgivable!! I will avenge you without fail!
You all should head back to base and focus on recovering.
...Unforgivable!! I swear I'll avenge this!
You all should head back to base and focus on recovering.
Got it. I'll avenge you, count on it.
You all should head back to base and focus on recovering.
Understood... I'll avenge this, I swear!
Everyone, please go back to base and focus on recovering.
Understood... Whatever happens, the target will be annihilated.
You should go back to base and focus on recovering.
Roger. 00, eliminating the target.
You all, return to base and focus on recovering.
Yes... We'll do just that.
You should hurry to the next venue too. There's not much time left.
...What the hell is this place!
Dada's corpse has been left lying here! ...But its special weapon was gone.
...That's odd. This is supposed to be District C, isn't it?
Ankh and the others waited there for a while, but their opponent never showed up.
There was no sign of the beam ropes being set up, either.
Then, suddenly, something appeared on the monitor.

Notice: Match Venue Change
Venue changed due to a beam rope malfunction.
Venue: Floor 3 NE - Ultra Tower
The Ultra Tower...!?
The Ultra Tower...!?
The Ultra Tower...!?
The Ultra Tower...!?
What's wrong?
No... It shouldn't be easy to get inside the tower, though...
Well... in a situation like this, its defense system probably isn't working either.
No... It shouldn't be easy to get inside the tower, though...
Well... in a situation like this, its defense system probably isn't working either.
Oh, no... It's just that the tower shouldn't be easy to get into...
Well... in a situation like this, I don't think the defense system is working either.
No... It shouldn't be easy to get inside the tower, though...
Well... in a situation like this, the defense system's probably down too, huh.
I see. Whoa... never mind that, we're out of time.
The time remaining was displayed in the corner of the monitor.
Time Remaining: 1:59:59
...We're down to less than two hours.
For now, let's follow the instructions and head for the Ultra Tower.

notes.note: Leader variants from 0430.bla Pt_Chara_Check: Ultra block #0.7-0.10 and #0.18-0.25 = Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero; Ankh block #0.53-0.70 pairs = OOO, Shotaro, Momotaros, RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00 (confirmed by voice). #0.8 = Seven, same Japanese as Ultraman's #0.7 (story_075).
Ankh: the Alien Alliance's next opponent is Ankh's team (confirmed by #0.46 and the match board in 0429).
#0.13/#0.48 duplicate the second half of #0.12/#0.47 and are not called by the script; given the same English as that half.
Sentence runs across #0.15-0.16 (and #0.50-0.51); cut at the matching point. Black King not in glossary (standard English name).

Avenge-lines: subject restored as 'we' where unstated and the leader speaks for the team; 'I' where the speaker stresses himself (Zero, Momotaros) or speaks personally (RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta). Jack is alive; 'avenge' kept for the source idiom (repay the defeat).
District B/C follows story_068's 'City District A' board wording; trailing sentence kept unfinished as in source.
#0.43-0.45 are not called by the script (unused leftovers). #0.44 has no speaker; read as a casual party leader consoling Jack, #0.45 as Jack's reply.
Setsuna's catchphrase as established elsewhere ('00, eliminating the target').
Narration; Dada g=n so 'its'. Dedicated weapon rendered 'special weapon'.
'Beam rope' = the energy ring ropes marking a match area; no earlier English precedent found.
Deliberate two-line notice layout (title + body) kept with a line break.
Match-board format as in story_068: 'Venue: Floor N <dir> - <place>'. Ultra Tower not in glossary.
0435.bla chain: #0.8-0.11 and pairs #0.13-0.20 = Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero. #0.24-0.25 labelled ?party (any leader), voiced neutrally.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant orders from 0430/0435.bla Pt_Chara_Check chains. Uncertain: 0430 #0.43-0.45 unused rows, #0.44 speaker inferred; 'we' vs 'I' on avenge-lines chosen per voice. Not in glossary: Black King, Ultra Tower, beam rope, District B/C (board style from story_068).
